content:
The grid forms a \(5\times 4\) rectangle, whose area is
\[
5\cdot 4=20.
\]

Two triangular corners are not part of the shaded polygon:

- Upper-right triangle: legs \(3\) and \(2\), area
\[
\frac12(3)(2)=3.
\]
- Lower-left triangle: legs \(1\) and \(1\), area
\[
\frac12(1)(1)=\frac12.
\]

Thus the shaded area is
\[
20-3-\frac12=16.5=\frac{33}{2}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{33}{2}\text{ square units}\approx 16.5\text{ square units}}
\]
